create_RearrangeTask: create a RearrangeTask instance with a RearrangeSim and dataset for object rearrangement episodes
reset_RearrangeTask: reset the RearrangeTask for a new episode and optionally fetch initial observations
step_RearrangeTask: step the RearrangeTask forward with an action dict and return updated observations
get_coll_forces_RearrangeTask: get collision force data for an articulated agent including max object and agent forces
duplicate_sensor_suite_RearrangeTask: duplicate articulated agent sensors in the sensor suite for multi-agent rearrangement tasks
